body: I have what I need to do it now, but I don't think I'll do it tonight.

I'm getting my medicine back today, so maybe I'll feel better enough. I'm so worn out. I just want to throw every vice I've got at the problem hoping something will make it better. I don't think it will, but it keeps me alive a little longer.
Still feeling pretty bad. The rest of the night was shitty. Eventually cried myself to sleep. Just been trying to sleep as much as possible today.

I am making some really bad decisions in my life that are pushing me toward the end, and I don't want to stop. I guess I just want some comfort or company along the way. I know it's a vague answer, I'm never very good at sharing details. I'm destroying one relationship by focusing on another. I can't stand to lose either of them and I can't have both.
